 from datetime import date
 
-from weekly_report import render, write_report

+
+DAY = date(2026, 3, 2)
+STOCK = {"tins": 8, "lids": 3}
 
 
 def test_render_flags_low_stock():
@@ -13,3 +16,51 @@ def test_write_creates_the_file(tmp_path):
     p = tmp_path / "r.txt"
     write_report(str(p), {"tins": 8}, date(2026, 3, 2))
     assert "Stock report for week of 2026-03-02" in p.read_text()
+
+
+def test_missing_file_gets_report_only(tmp_path):
+    p = tmp_path / "new.txt"
+    write_report(str(p), STOCK, DAY)
+    assert p.read_text() == render(STOCK, DAY) + "\n"
+
+
+def test_two_runs_one_copy_and_stable_size(tmp_path):
+    p = tmp_path / "r.txt"
+    p.write_text(f"Header\n{MARKER}\n")
+    write_report(str(p), STOCK, DAY)
+    size = p.stat().st_size
+    write_report(str(p), STOCK, DAY)
+    assert p.stat().st_size == size
+    text = p.read_text()
+    assert text.count("Stock report for week of") == 1
+    assert text == f"Header\n{MARKER}\n" + render(STOCK, DAY) + "\n"
+
+
+def test_old_report_replaced_by_latest(tmp_path):
+    p = tmp_path / "r.txt"
+    p.write_text(f"Header\n{MARKER}\nOLD REPORT\nmore old\n")
+    write_report(str(p), STOCK, DAY)
+    text = p.read_text()
+    assert "OLD REPORT" not in text
+    assert text.endswith(render(STOCK, DAY) + "\n")
+
+
+def test_header_and_marker_bytes_unchanged(tmp_path):
+    p = tmp_path / "r.txt"
+    head = f"Notes  \r\n\tindented\r\n{MARKER}\r\n".encode()
+    p.write_bytes(head + b"stale\n")
+    write_report(str(p), STOCK, DAY)
+    assert p.read_bytes().startswith(head)
+    write_report(str(p), STOCK, DAY)
+    assert p.read_bytes().startswith(head)
+
+
+def test_no_marker_keeps_content_and_is_idempotent(tmp_path):
+    p = tmp_path / "r.txt"
+    p.write_text("Some existing notes\n")
+    write_report(str(p), STOCK, DAY)
+    first = p.read_text()
+    assert first.startswith(f"Some existing notes\n{MARKER}\n")
+    assert first.count("Stock report for week of") == 1
+    write_report(str(p), STOCK, DAY)
+    assert p.read_text() == first

@@ -2,6 +2,8 @@
 import os
 from datetime import date
 
+MARKER = "--- report below ---"
+
 
 def render(stock, day):
     lines = [f"Stock report for week of {day.isoformat()}", ""]
@@ -11,11 +13,28 @@ def render(stock, day):
     return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
 
 
+def _head_through_marker(text):
+    """Return the text up to and including the marker line (adding the marker if absent)."""
+    pos = 0
+    for line in text.splitlines(keepends=True):
+        pos += len(line)
+        if line.rstrip("\r\n") == MARKER:
+            head = text[:pos]
+            return head if head.endswith(("\n", "\r")) else head + "\n"
+    sep = "" if not text or text.endswith(("\n", "\r")) else "\n"
+    return text + sep + MARKER + "\n"
+
+
 def write_report(path, stock, day=None):
     day = day or date.today()
-    with open(path, "a") as fh:
-        fh.write(render(stock, day))
-        fh.write("\n")
+    report = render(stock, day) + "\n"
+    try:
+        with open(path, newline="") as fh:
+            head = _head_through_marker(fh.read())
+    except FileNotFoundError:
+        head = ""
+    with open(path, "w", newline="") as fh:
+        fh.write(head + report)
